paths: scripts/lib/sw-precache.ts (the prefix and the exclusions became the game's; the asset folder list added; writes the kit's sw.js itself)
public/sw.js (the cache prefix read from the precache)
src/ui/sw.ts (registerServiceWorker takes the build's env and the worker's url)
e2e/phone/offline.spec.ts and e2e/phone/lib/offline-server.ts (as offline.e2e.test.ts on a small build)
src/ui/freshBuild.ts (safe-to-reload, flush, once at a time; the game's screens became `safe`)
src/ui/build.ts (the build commit for display: buildStamp)
src/ui/offline.ts, src/ui/offline.test.ts (pageHost and framed: no service worker inside a frame)
